post.description:
Store a file and queue it for processing. The same file twice is one document.

PDFs, office files and images are accepted. A PDF's pages are counted here; any other
file is made into a PDF in the worker, and its pages are counted there.

get.description: The organisation's documents, newest first, each with its stage.

delete.description:
Delete a document. It is kept for its audit trail but disappears from every list,
read, search, answer, knowledge base and export; the same file can be uploaded again
as a new document.

get.description: The extraction of the newest version that succeeded.
What was checked on the newest extracted version, and whether a person must look.

post.description:
Queue a new version. Earlier versions and their extractions are kept. In a free
workspace each is a reading, counted with uploads toward its readings a day.

get.description: Every stage the document has reached, with when, and the reason if it failed.

schema.title: Response Get Timeline V1 Documents  Document Id  Timeline Get

get.description:
Server-sent events: each new stage as it is reached, ending once the document is
ready, processed or failed (or after ten minutes; reconnect to continue).

schema.title: Response Get Audit Trail V1 Documents  Document Id  Audit Get

get.description:
Recompute the audit log's hash chain and report the first break, if any.

`consistent` means the stored hashes agree with the stored entries. It shows that no
entry was edited or removed from the middle without the later hashes being redone;
it cannot show that the log was not rewritten by someone able to redo them.
The caller's workspace: how many documents, where they are, and what they cost.

post.description:
Sign in: an organisation's reviewer with its name, their email and PIN; an
account's person with their email and password alone.

get.description: Who the credential stands for: for the web app's name and role-aware navigation.

post.description: Make an account - a private workspace with you in it - and sign in to it.

get.description: Documents waiting for a person, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Review Queue V1 Review Queue Get

post.description:
Claim the review for a few minutes, or renew the claim; call again to keep it.

While another reviewer's claim lasts it is returned unchanged (`mine` false), and
their changes alone are accepted; an administrator may `take_over`.

delete.description: End the caller's claim. Someone else's is left alone (still 204).

get.description: The committed eval reports, summarised for the eval and cost page.
What a webhook may subscribe to.

schema.title: Response Events V1 Webhooks Events Get

patch.description: Disable (stop sending, keep it) or enable again (the destination is re-checked).

schema.title: Response Set Active V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Patch

delete.description: Stops for good: out of the list, its deliveries kept as a record.

post.description: A new signing secret, shown once; the old one stops verifying at once.

get.description: Newest first; for the next page, `before` is the last one's id.

schema.title: Response Deliveries V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Deliveries Get

post.description: Queue a `webhook.test` event for this webhook.

schema.title: Response Send Test V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Test Post

post.description: Send a failed delivery again, with its own event id and fresh attempts.

schema.title: Response Resend V1 Webhooks  Webhook Id  Deliveries  Delivery Id  Resend Post

get.description: Every signed record of the organisation, one row each, newest first.
The same, with each signed record in full.

schema.title: Response Documents Json V1 Exports Documents Json Get

post.description:
Server-sent events: a `stage` event as each stage begins (searching, reading with
the number of passages, checking), then the checked `answer`, or an `error`. The
answer's text is never streamed before its quotes are checked.

get.description:
What the organisation asked that its documents could not answer, and why: the
documents worth adding. Administrators only: it shows everyone's questions.

schema.title: Response List Conversations V1 Conversations Get

delete.description: The conversation and every question and answer in it, deleted for good.

schema.title: Response List Collections V1 Collections Get

delete.description: The knowledge base goes; its documents stay.

schema.title: Response List Members V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Get

post.description: All of them or none: a document not in the organisation refuses the lot.

schema.title: Response Add Members V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Post

get.description: Newest first. `before` is the `next_before` of the last page.
The filtered view, newest first, at most 10,000 rows; the export is logged.

Every workspace's figures, most recently active first, and the totals. Counts and
names only: never a document's name or contents.
What happened in every workspace (or one), newest first, as labels: no details.

schema.title: Response Keys V1 Api Keys Get

post.description: A read-only key for an AI agent. Its token is in this reply only.

schema.title: Response Calls V1 Agent Calls Get

413.description: File too large or too many pages

503.description: The model quota is used up

BBox.description: A rectangle in PDF points with the origin at the bottom-left of the page.

Block.title: Block
Block.description: One piece of text on a page. `id` is what an extracted field cites.

CostOut.title: CostOut
CostOut.description: Every reading of the document; thinking tokens are counted as output.

LoginIn.title: LoginIn
LoginIn.description:
An organisation's reviewer gives its name, the email and the PIN; an account's person
gives only the email and the password. Either secret may travel in either field.
